page.layout: One page of a book cover or flyleaf: blank paper with a handwritten pencil note in the lower part; no printed text. Dark book board frames the page.
page.notes: The only writing is a manuscript pencil note in the lower left of the leaf: "NICHT in Wellisch (vgl. A-40)" and "Kat. 2. 78 es". This is handwriting, not printed text, so it is left out of the main text. The page has no printed running head, page number, catchword or signature. Paper patches and book board are visible at the edges.
